memberJudgments.reason: Hui’s annals explicitly capture Lun’s faction Sun Xiu and quote the restoration edict blaming him for installing Lun; the same coup adviser is killed with his sons. Quoted assessments remain attributed, not new personal facts.
The Yu deposition omen says Sun Xiu and Zhang Lin subsequently took power, matching the same adviser and conspirator in the detailed ZZT083 court narrative.
After Yu’s deposition, Zhao Prince Lun and Sun Xiu exploit resentment to depose Jia; the exact partners and event match Jin053 and ZZT083.

Sun Xiu arranges Yang’s empress appointment through Sun Qi’s clan ties after Jia’s deposition; ZZT083s0354 repeats the same empress/grandfather/adviser relation. No numerical date is needed for this identity.
Fu Zhi’s biography names Sun Xiu with Yiyang Prince Wei drafting Lun’s abdication documents; Lun’s usurpation and restoration of Hui identify the same adviser.

The chapter explicitly calls Sun Xiu Zhao Prince Lun’s strategist. Sima Ya/Xu Chao persuade him, he urges delaying Yu’s restoration until Jia kills Yu, then spreads disinformation. This exact sequence recurs in ZZT083.

A later memorial retrospectively names Sun Xiu’s usurpation manipulation and Hui losing control; the immediately preceding frame explicitly names Zhao Prince Lun’s usurpation and the three princes’ resistance. Not a later contemporary.
The Yu deposition omen names Sun Xiu and Zhang Lin taking power, parallel to Jin028 and the actual Lun court narrative.

The later memorial explicitly looks back to the Western court’s failed rewards, Chen Huai supporting Sun Xiu and the Huainan disaster. That distinctive Lun/Yun conflict identifies the same Sun Xiu, not a Song official.
The full named Sun Xiu joins Lun in Jia’s overthrow, persuades him to delay until Yu dies, spreads disinformation and sends Sima Ya to Zhang Hua. Exact Jin053 parallels support the same adviser.

Immediately following the coup, Sun Xiu controls Lun and becomes Zhongshu Ling. Continuous actor references and court sequence link this local record to p074, not a new adviser. The actual 中書令 office retains its Chinese text and now correctly uses Secretariat Director. Both same-person 秀 occurrences remain in s0284; title translation does not create another adviser.

The continuous Lun/Xiu/Yun narrative, Pan Yue flashback, Shi Chong/Luzhu dispute, nine bestowals, offices and son Hui identify the same adviser. Pan Yue is the one who previously flogged Sun Xiu in Chinese; this flashback does not create a second Xiu. The actual s0323 idiomatic correction now agrees with 岳屢撻之: Pan Yue flogged Sun Xiu. This retrospective personal grievance and the ensuing Shi Chong/Pan Yue arrests still identify the same adviser; source31’s s0320 Yun actor and s0332 maternal-brother corrections concern other people.

Genuine s0354 孫秀/秀 arranges Yang’s installation through her grandfather Sun Qi, exactly parallel to Jin031s0607–s0608 and continuous with the Lun court. Current c0283 is solely s0354 and all three owned mentions are s0354. The source31 repair has transferred the foreign Li Xiang reference at s0386 to its actual owner; no genuine Sun Xiu evidence was lost.
